name: 3 · Umbrella evidence: monthly request → payslip checks

parameters.content:
## 3 · Umbrella evidence: monthly request → payslip checks
Joint and several liability (from 6 April 2026): agencies need documented checks, ongoing monitoring and records.
Checks: R1 hours = approved · R2 income = hours × assignment rate · R3 taxable pay ≥ National Living Wage · R4 non-taxable payments. Flags are for human review, not decisions.

### 1st of the month 09:00 (or from the console): evidence request
Secure upload link to each umbrella paying our temps; a reminder if nothing has arrived.

### Umbrella company opens the upload link
Shows the workers and the CSV columns expected.

### Umbrella uploads payslip CSV → checks
Every line checked and recorded (audit trail); compliance gets one email with any flags.

meta.description: Requests monthly payslip evidence from each umbrella company and checks it against approved hours, assignment rates, the National Living Wage and non-taxable payments.
